statements.statement: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered for this patient
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
There is concern for supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The patient has symptomatic complaints of giddiness
The diagnosis codes I48.0, I47.1, and R42 are listed
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The intermittent nature of arrhythmic events requires extended ambulatory monitoring to capture the episodes
This diagnostic procedure is clinically necessary to confirm the underlying arrhythmia and guide appropriate rate or rhythm control therapy
